title: Evacuation Traffic Prediction for Dynamic Transportation Networks over Multiple Hurricanes: A Generalized Graph Learning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.34687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High traffic demand during hurricane evacuations causes severe congestion on major highways, leading to delays and safety risks for evacuees. Predicting evacuation traffic in real-time can significantly enhance evacuation management efforts. However, evacuation traffic is highly dynamic and uncertain due to evolving hurricane characteristics and diverse population response. Each hurricane has unique characteristics and evacuation contexts, resulting in different spatial-temporal traffic patterns. Moreover, the structure of detector-based transportation networks varies across multiple hurricanes. Hence, a model trained on the data from one hurricane may not generalize well for others. This study proposes a generalized dynamic graph learning framework using traffic detectors and evacuation data from 12 historical hurricanes. translated_title: 多飓风期间动态交通网络的疏散交通预测：一种广义图学习方法
translated_abstract: 飓风疏散期间的高交通需求导致主要高速公路严重拥堵，给疏散人员带来延误和安全风险。实时预测疏散交通可以显著增强疏散管理工作。然而，由于飓风特征的不断演变和人群响应的多样性，疏散交通高度动态且具有不确定性。每场飓风都有独特的特征和疏散背景，导致不同的时空交通模式。此外，基于检测器的交通网络结构在多场飓风之间也存在差异。因此，在一场飓风数据上训练的模型可能无法很好地泛化到其他飓风。本研究利用来自12场历史飓风的交通检测器和疏散数据，提出了一个广义动态图学习框架。利用交通网络的动态特性，我们开发了一种图卷积长短期记忆网络
tldr: 本研究利用12场历史飓风的检测器和疏散数据，提出一种广义动态图学习框架（图卷积LSTM），实现跨多场飓风的疏散交通预测并解决模型泛化难题。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a generalized dynamic graph learning framework (Graph Convolutional LSTM) using data from 12 historical hurricanes to enable evacuation traffic prediction that generalizes across multiple hurricanes with varying network structures and spatio-temporal patterns.
